customer_persona: Everyday compact-SUV buyers comparing driving choices, passenger and luggage space, useful equipment and ownership costs. No individual route, budget, family, location or preferred trim is known unless the buyer supplies it.
decision_frame: The strongest fit is the engine and trim whose gearbox, seating and equipment match what you need, and the thing still to verify is that version’s current on-road quote.
takeaway: Choose the engine and trim together, then check that exact version’s features and current on-road quote.
primary_outcome: Identify an engine-and-trim combination to verify against the buyer’s own requirements.
supporting_outcomes: Understand the supported seating, assistance and comfort choices.
Know which price, policy and measured evidence still need confirmation.

concerns.why: The separate engines have different gearbox pairings, while fuel-use and performance measurements have not been supplied.
The split seat and rear recline explain arrangement choices but do not establish personal passenger, luggage or parking fit.
Standard airbags and selected-trim assistance establish equipment rather than a crash-test rating.
The conflicting dated entry price is not a current local quote and extended petrol warranty is separately paid.
Measured fuel economy, service costs and resale evidence are missing.

voice.persona_description: The guide is a practical product guide who pays attention to the buyer’s questions. The guide explains one useful thought at a time, with warmth and candour about missing evidence.
voice.tone: Cheerful, attentive Indian English with everyday words, short connected thoughts and restrained pauses.
voice.sample_line: Hi, welcome to the Hyundai CRETA; would you like to share what you’re looking for in your next car, or shall we get started?

visual_gaps.what: Automatic gear controls and the current engine-to-trim matrix
visual_gaps.why: The manual lever and engine illustrations do not show automatic selectors or establish every current combination; S(O) Knight automatic feature rows need reconciling with the engine matrix.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload labelled automatic-selector photographs and the current official engine matrix checked against the relevant feature footnotes.

visual_gaps.what: Ground clearance, suspension and documented ride result
visual_gaps.why: The wheel close-ups cannot establish speed-breaker clearance, suspension specification or measured rough-road comfort.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload official dimensions/suspension tables and an identified road test with trim, tyres and surfaces.

visual_gaps.what: Rear recline operation, rear vents, rear armrest and rear sunshade
visual_gaps.why: The rear panorama is contextual; the seatback-table, front-armrest and front-vent pictures do not literally show these different rear features.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload labelled close-ups of the rear recline control, rear vent, deployed rear armrest/cupholders and rear-window shade on identified trims.

visual_gaps.what: Measured luggage capacity, legroom and parking dimensions
visual_gaps.why: Folded seats and sample bags establish no boot litres, rear legroom or personal parking fit.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload the official capacity/dimensions table and use the buyer’s actual passengers, bags or parking measurements for a personal check.

visual_gaps.what: Rear parking sensors, hill-start operation and both axle brakes
visual_gaps.why: Camera screens are not sensor images, and one visible wheel caliper cannot show the complete front/rear brake setup or hill-start operation.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload labelled rear-sensor photos, front and rear brake images and a clearly identified hill-start demonstration.

visual_gaps.what: Wireless mirroring and the required adapter
visual_gaps.why: The charging pad and seatback tablet are different subjects; the dashboard serves only as context for F045/F046.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload a compatible phone actively mirrored to the car display and the wired-to-wireless adapter used on SX and above.

visual_gaps.what: Cooled glove box and ambient lighting
visual_gaps.why: The glove-box cooling mechanism has no supplied literal picture, and ambient lighting also lacks an approved fact.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload an identified glove-box cooling image and an official feature-availability entry with a matching photo before adding ambient lighting.

visual_gaps.why: No supplied image literally shows the conflicting entry amounts, a current on-road quotation or policy terms; exterior images remain contextual.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload a reconciled official price listing, current itemised local engine/trim quotation and official standard/paid extended-warranty documents.

visual_gaps.what: Applicable crash-test and measured driving or cooling evidence
visual_gaps.why: Airbag, assistance, engine and airflow illustrations do not establish a crash score, acceleration, loaded climb, fuel economy, noise or cooldown time.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Supply the applicable official crash report, engine/gearbox fuel certification and identified tests with load, environment and measurement basis.

visual_gaps.what: Service, resale, stock, delivery and booking evidence
visual_gaps.why: The registry supplies no local maintenance/access figures, retained-value evidence, live stock, delivery promise or test-drive destination.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Obtain official service information, a local maintenance estimate, documented comparable resale evidence if needed, dealer stock/delivery confirmation and a verified booking destination.

intake.q1: Hi, welcome to the Hyundai CRETA; would you like to share what you’re looking for in your next car, or shall we get started?

do_not_recommend_if: Do not recommend a specific version while a non-negotiable requirement depends on missing fuel-economy, safety-test, personal-fit, price or availability evidence.
advance: When the buyer wants to verify a version, offer Request dealer contact so the selected Hyundai dealer can confirm the engine and trim and supply a current itemised on-road quotation; selecting the CTA records a contact preference and optional follow-up, not completed contact or booking.
